notes.title: COLD GENERATORS BIOM IS READY!!!!!
notes.content:
Hey friends! 👋

Today’s a big one – we finally wrapped up the Cold Generators biome! This is a huge milestone for our little team, and honestly, if it weren’t for your constant support and activity, this project wouldn’t even exist. 💖

We’ve been absolutely loving your feedback, your crazy gameplay clips, and all the YouTube runs you’ve shared – seriously, THANK YOU! 🙏
We’re super excited to roll out the updated starting biome for you to explore!

A lot of our time this month went into behind-the-scenes stuff (which we’re not usually fans of), but the good news is:

🎉 BIG CHANGES:
Cold Generators Biome is here!

6 New Unique Enemies!

Character Selection System Added!

Sergeant – Can dash

Captain – Can summon Purge Squad (all with different weapons)

Fish Treator – Can throw scythe across

Inquisitor – Can harvest enemies and throw corpses

Huge Balance Changes:

Player can now buy non-permanent artifacts & weapons (🟨 yellow carpet shop)

Player can now buy permanent meta-progression gear for next runs (🔴 red carpet trader)

Experience system added – On reaching max level, a chest appears with 3 artifact choices

Level-up animation added
GAMEPLAY TWEAKS:
Challenge #1: Mission Azretea –

Senator Big Fish Boss added to challenges (replaces Cold Generators boss)

Big Jellyfish waves added

Berserk wave added
MINOR UPDATES:
Pause screen added

Death screen added

Settings screen added
NEXT WEEK:

We’re jumping back on the content train 🚂 – and if all goes well, you might see some mysterious new things sneaking into the game… 👀
